## Body

F268 supersedes the earlier gap-reconcile concurrency-only conclusion: follow_lapses_every now waits until10s after the previous reconcile COMPLETES before attaching/reconciling a gap. One startup scan plus at most0.1 later full scans/s; no periodic quiet-fleet tick. It is a one-shot timer brake, not a new poll. Direct live lapse checks and total-broadcast receiver copying are not rate-limited by that brake.

outstanding now asks latest_matching for FOUR kinds, not three. That is four indexed seeks plus schema/read-snapshot work per native seat or live lapse check. A single port call is not one SQL statement.

Failed renewal retries occur only on another incoming heartbeat. Default60s lease/divisor3 recommends20s, not a server request-rate limit. The F260 merge re-enters recover_held on EVERY marked heartbeat before publishing renewed: even with zero held bodies it opens the queue write transaction and scans recipient failed history. Price that plus the edge-write attempt under the native lock. Already-recovered rows are pending and are not redelivered by the held recovery guard.

Told/Pending lapse decisions add one held event/write/broadcast. Successful persistence suppresses future re-decisions of that edge; failed persistence can retry on later event/reconcile activity. remembered() excludes held facts, so the30min acting window is unchanged.

Retry is eventual persistence, not immediate: until the next successful heartbeat, the old spine lapse can still be latest. Gap scans may run after10s against a20s recommended heartbeat gap. The dropped/undecided-lapse ordering belongs to correctness review and was flagged there; a cost pass does not clear it.
